s1.syndrome_frame: A painful polypoid mass on the gingiva with bone resorption and atypical cells
salient_findings: 10-mm polypoid mass on the left lower gingiva
Moth-eaten pattern of mandibular bone resorption
Atypical spindle and pleomorphic cells in a fibrin-rich edematous stroma
Irregular mandibular bone destruction
Presence of trismus
key_facts: 69-year-old Japanese man
Pain and a polypoid mass on the left lower gingiva
History of chemoradiotherapy for squamous cell carcinoma of the left buccal mucosa
No tobacco or alcohol use
Normal vital signs
Trismus present
Rough-surfaced polypoid lesion in the left lower molar gingiva
Whitish pseudomembrane covering the lesion
Moth-eaten pattern of mandibular bone resorption on panoramic radiography
Enhancing soft-tissue mass with irregular mandibular bone destruction on contrast-enhanced CT
Biopsy specimen showed loose granulation tissue with scattered atypical cells
Spindle cells had basophilic cytoplasm, bizarre nuclei, and atypical mitoses
Immunohistochemical staining revealed positivity for vimentin, α-smooth muscle actin, p63, p53, and CD68
Ki-67 labeling index was approximately 50%

shortlist.label: Sarcomatoid squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of squamous cell carcinoma and presence of atypical spindle cells

shortlist.label: Spindle cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of spindle cells with basophilic cytoplasm and atypical mitoses

shortlist.label: Malignant fibrous histiocytoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of atypical cells and positivity for vimentin and CD68

shortlist.label: Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of atypical spindle and pleomorphic cells with high Ki-67 labeling index

shortlist.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of spindle cells with basophilic cytoplasm and atypical mitoses, and positivity for vimentin and α-smooth muscle actin

raw.rationale: The patient's history of squamous cell carcinoma and the presence of atypical spindle cells with positivity for p63, a marker often expressed in squamous cell carcinomas, support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Spindle cell carcinoma
rejected.why: While similar, spindle cell carcinoma is less likely given the specific context of sarcomatoid features and history of squamous cell carcinoma

rejected.label: Malignant fibrous histiocytoma
rejected.why: Now considered a subtype of undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma, and the immunohistochemical profile does not strongly support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma
rejected.why: Lack of specific markers and the presence of p63 positivity point away from this diagnosis

rejected.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
rejected.why: Typically has a more benign clinical course and lacks the high-grade atypia and mitotic activity seen in this case
